$comment: English texts of data/winter.json (src/engine/winter.js): the names of the camp's decorations and the words of the calendar's window and tab.

texts.title: Generous Feast
texts.lead: From 1 to 24 December, one reward a day for coming into the game. Whoever takes all 24 windows gets the winter set on the 24th. A day missed is lost.
texts.taken: Taken. Come back tomorrow for the next window.
texts.done: The whole calendar is taken. Happy Generous Feast!
texts.decorationGot: {name} will stand in your Camp until the end of December.
texts.setGot: The winter set is yours: the Hoarfrost frame, the Generous Feast background and the Snowstorm aura wait in the System Shop, ready to wear.
texts.closed: The Generous Feast calendar opens from 1 to 24 December.
texts.alreadyTaken: Today's window is already open. Come back tomorrow.
texts.bagFull: The bag is full. Make room in it for the potions and take the reward.
texts.changed: The calendar changed in the meantime. Try again.
texts.saleLead: From 12 to 24 December you can buy here any piece of the winter set you do not have yet. Outside this window the set is not for sale.
texts.saleSoon: From 12 December you can also buy the winter set here for System Points.
texts.bought: Bought: {name}. Put it on in the System Shop.
texts.saleClosed: You can buy the winter set here from 12 to 24 December.
texts.saleUnknown: That is not part of the winter set.
texts.salePoints: Not enough System Points: you need {price}.
texts.tabWaiting: Generous Feast calendar: the reward of December {day} is waiting
texts.tabTaken: Generous Feast calendar: the reward of December {day} is taken
texts.questFirHint: A fir branch every {minutes} minutes of exploring.
texts.questCarp: Catch a carp for Christmas Eve
texts.questFish: Catch a fish for Christmas Eve
texts.questDish: Cook a dish in the System Kitchen
texts.questsChest: All the day's winter quests bring a card pack.
texts.questsNote: Winter quests come every day in December and cannot be rerolled.

fortunes: This wax set for you, not for your character. Your character is only holding the candle.
When you switch off the screen tonight, someone will think of you. It won't be anyone from the game.
When you put the phone down, look around. Something in your room has long been waiting for your attention.
Your character collects gold. This month you will collect something more precious.
The System sees only your character. The fortune sees you too, on the other side of the screen.
The next message from outside the game to reach your phone will bring good news.
Your character rests between fights. You deserve it too, and sooner than you think.
The first person to speak to you tomorrow has more for you than they will say.
The cups don't lie: in the real world a chest is waiting for you too. You only have to open it.
Someone next to you doesn't know you're telling your fortune right now. Let it stay that way for now.
Before the week ends, someone will ask you for advice. Your character would be proud of you.
Your level in the game grows with every expedition. Your real level grows quietly, even today.
The tea you drink today will taste better if you make a wish over it.
Before you fall asleep, recall one good thing from today. Tomorrow it will come back with interest.
The screen lights only your face. This candle will light your tomorrow as well.
Expeditions in the game last for hours. Your most important journey this winter will start with one step out the door.
Someone in your real life needs just one word today. You know who.
Your character will get a bonus today. You will get something more lasting: a good idea just before sleep.
The wax sees your hands, not your character's. They are stronger than you think.
Your next dream won't be about the game. Remember it.
Your character has companions from the Tavern. You have someone who would stand behind you without pay.
The next time you glance at a clock and see matching digits, the fortune will come true.
Not every treasure drops from champions. One lies in a drawer you haven't opened in a long time.
Somewhere on the other side of another screen, someone is telling their fortune right now too. They wish you well.
Your Time Points refill on their own. So does your time, if you rest a little today.
Something is happening outside your window right now that you won't see in any land. Take a look.
Someone is waiting for you to look up from the screen and smile. See if it's today.
The next thing you lose won't be gone for good. It will come back at the best moment.
Your character doesn't know you're playing it. You don't know yet how good your December will be.
The words you read outside the game today will hold a hidden meaning. Look for the third sentence.
They say a fortune comes true once you forget it. So forget it and play on.
At your next meal in the real world you'll get a bonus to your mood.
The best find of this week won't go into your character's bag, but into your memory.
Tonight the System closes its eyes for a moment. Do something just for yourself.
Someone you play with remembers your name better than you think.
This weekend will bring you something no expedition can: a good conversation.
The number that catches your eye three times today outside the game will be your lucky one until the year ends.
The next time you lose signal, take it as a sign. Rest.
Your character sleeps when you sleep. Go to bed a little earlier tonight, and tomorrow's expedition will go better.
This fortune will come true only halfway. The other half is up to you.

texts.title: Fortune Evening
texts.lead: St Andrew's Eve: two evenings of fortune-telling. Each evening you tell your fortune once; the omen gives a bonus for a day and a small gift to start with.
texts.waxAbout: Wax from the candle drips through the eye of an old key into a bowl of water and sets into a shape. Its shadow on the wall hints at what awaits you.
texts.waxResult: The wax set into a shape: {omen}.
texts.cupsAbout: Under one of the three cups lies a wax figurine from last night. Pick a cup.
texts.cupsResult: Under the cup lay a figurine: {omen}.
texts.toldWax: This evening's fortune is told. Tomorrow: three cups.
texts.both: For fortunes on both evenings: the portrait background “St Andrew's Eve” and the achievement “St Andrew's Fortune”.
texts.bothGot: For fortunes on both evenings you get the portrait background “St Andrew's Eve”, and a title waits in Achievements.
texts.locked: The Fortune Evening waits at the Enchantress's in the Settlement, and the Settlement unlocks at character level {level}.
texts.taken: This evening's fortune is already told.
texts.changed: Something changed in the meantime. Try again.
